name: Married Couples
overview: Scripture presents marriage as a sacred union ordained by God, where a man and woman become one flesh, leaving their parents to form a new, unified relationship (Genesis 2:24; Matthew 19:6). Husbands are called to love their wives deeply, while wives are instructed to respect their husbands, reflecting Christ-like love and reverence within the marriage bond (Ephesians 5:33). Furthermore, marriage is honored as pure and undefiled, with God’s judgment reserved for those who violate this covenant through unfaithfulness (Hebrews 13:4).
